question: Does an existing official access record show a practical route to obtain the 1995 Sorsogon Bay fisheries assessment cited by the 2009 NFRDI paper?

sourcesReviewed.title: Resource and Ecological Assessment of Sorsogon Bay, Philippines, Vol. I to III - FOI response
sourcesReviewed.provider: Freedom of Information Philippines / Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources
sourcesReviewed.access: The official page reports an earlier request for the 1995 Sorsogon Bay assessment Volumes I-III. BFAR replied that it had a physical copy, was still digitizing books and IEC materials, and had no softcopy available at that time; it suggested direct coordination with DA-BFAR Regional Fisheries Office.

assessment.acquisitionLead: The 2009 NFRDI Sorsogon Bay assessment cites a 1995 fish checklist in Volume II (pages 79-97). The archived 2022 FOI response indicates that BFAR had a physical copy of the three-volume assessment and points to the regional fisheries office as a possible follow-up channel.

missingEvidence: The 1995 Volume II checklist pages were not obtained or inspected.
No digital scan, species table, identification method, collection-event crosswalk or vouchers were exposed by the response.
The response does not state whether inspection or scanning is now available, which regional office holds a copy, or the rights and conditions for reuse.
The 1995 checklist is a historical catch list and would require taxonomic review, dated evidence interpretation and current-source corroboration before any present-day map claim.

disposition.reason: The official response offers a focused acquisition route but is only a 2022 status record and contains no assessment data or reuse grant.

nextAction: If Joseph chooses to pursue the lead, ask DA-BFAR Region V or the BFAR Central Office Library whether the specific 1995 Volume II pages 79-97 can be inspected or shared, what current request process applies, and what citation and reuse terms govern any scan. Do not assume the archived 2022 status still applies.

sources.supports: Official archived FOI request and BFAR response dated August 1, 2022 regarding physical-copy and then-current digitization status.
Official 2009 paper reference identifying the 1995 checklist by title, volume and pages 79-97.
